raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Make MRV2 output readiness cover speculative post-sampling KV writes before an opted-in connector can publish or reuse the affected blocks. This extracts the step-readiness fix and its capability from #58968, independently of its FULL-context and MultiConnector ownership changes.

Rebased onto main `bfa7e5b7afe40ebe48288801a2baf5c1135cd881`. This remains an independent child of closed #58968.

## Claims

- Retain early D2H submission, then extend the same output-ready event after draft and post-forward work ordered on the main stream.
- Apply this only with a speculator and `requires_full_step_completion=True`; the base/no-op default is false, disabled wrappers opt out, and MoRI opts in for READ only.
- Compose the capability with `any()` in MultiConnector without changing its ownership algorithm in this PR.

```text
submit early D2H -> draft / post-forward -> copy stream waits on main stream
-> re-record output-ready event -> output may become scheduler-visible
```

## Validation

Validated on `1fae964c45e47c43231985f95f4d94b1b5d99030` (2026-10-12): **51 passed**. Changed-file pre-commit passed, including mypy for Python 3.11 and test/CI tethering checks.

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -ra \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_kv_connector.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_tp_ack.py
```

Fresh negative control on the current main: the speculative-plus-opt-in ordering case fails, while the other three combinations pass. All four pass here. The suite also covers READ/WRITE opt-in, disabled/no-op adapters, early D2H, the same output event and the exact streams.

**Real HIP stream/event check:** on gfx950 with PyTorch `2.12.0+git6bbd260` / HIP `7.2.53211`, a controlled harness calls this checkout's actual `GPUModelRunner.sample_tokens()` and `AsyncOutput.get_output()`. Its sampler returns a token and its drafter enqueues a delayed device write (`torch.cuda._sleep(1_000_000_000)`, then a tensor fill and completion event). Across three repetitions per setting:

| Source / opt-in | Draft-write event complete when output becomes visible |
| --- | --- |
| Current main / enabled | 0 / 3 |
| This head / enabled | 3 / 3 |
| This head / disabled | 0 / 3 |

This checks device ordering with controlled sampler/drafter fixtures; it is not a model, RDMA, block-reuse stress or performance evaluation. Exact-source PD+DSpark accuracy and overlap/latency measurements remain pending.

The eight independent PRs compose on this same main. The combined CPU suite passes **344 tests**, with **33 skips** (32 ROCm/aiter-gated connector cases and one GPU LLM case) and **one model-loading deselection**. Counts overlap with the independent suites.

## Details

`AsyncOutput` records its copy event before `postprocess_sampled()` and `speculator.propose()`. Waiting for that event previously did not cover subsequent KV writes. Out-of-band RDMA cannot inherit the ordering of a later local GPU kernel, so output-triggered block reuse/source handoff needs that later completion boundary.

The capability is deliberately isolated here in response to the interface concern on #58968. It limits the behavior change to opted-in connectors. A runner-only condition based on active `kv_connector_output` would remove the API extension but broaden the readiness delay to all speculative KV connectors; a connector-local blocking wait could lose CPU/GPU overlap. Neither alternative's performance equivalence has been established. The necessity of this particular interface remains an explicit review point.

This is not #48464's MRV1 lifecycle API or #60544's hybrid WRITE transport. It does not replace producer ACK retention (#56465), transfer draining, or multi-owner release accounting. Only writes ordered on the main stream are covered.

**Merge impact:** reversible code change; opted-in speculative MRV2 output readiness. There is no new host synchronization between target and draft, but delaying readiness/shared-copy-stream work can affect overlap and needs measurement.

#60808's pre-forward READ barrier does not cover draft writes after sampling. #60867 extends hybrid READ to more groups/speculative methods; this PR does not claim hardware coverage for those new layouts. The output-readiness capability remains an explicit maintainer design-review point.

AI assistance was used for implementation, rebase, regression checks and this description. Human line-by-line review and the runtime acceptance items above remain pending. No performance improvement is claimed.

+def test_output_readiness_covers_draft_kv_writes(
+    monkeypatch, has_speculator: bool, requires_completion: bool
+):
+    """Publishing output must cover draft writes before RDMA can reuse KV."""
+    timeline: list[str] = []
+    writes: set[str] = set()
+    visible: set[str] = set()
+    ready: set[str] = set()
+    copy_stream = Mock()
+
+    def wait_stream(stream):
+        assert stream is runner.main_stream
+        timeline.append("wait")
+        visible.update(writes)
+
+    copy_stream.wait_stream.side_effect = wait_stream
+    event = Mock()
+
+    def record(stream):
+        assert stream is copy_stream
+        timeline.append("record")
+        ready.update(visible)
+
+    event.record.side_effect = record
+
+    def async_output(**kwargs):
+        timeline.append("d2h")
+        copy_stream.wait_stream(kwargs["main_stream"])
+        event.record(copy_stream)
+        return SimpleNamespace(copy_event=event)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(model_runner_module, "AsyncOutput", async_output)
+    runner = Mock()
+    runner.output_copy_stream = copy_stream
+    runner.is_last_pp_rank = True
+    runner.pcp_manager = None
+    runner.pp_handler = None
+    runner.aux_output_connector = None
+    runner.adaptive_verification = None
+    runner.num_speculative_steps = 0
+    runner._draft_workspace_lane = 0
+    runner.model = Mock(spec=["compute_logits"])
+    runner.kv_connector.requires_full_step_completion = requires_completion
+    runner.req_states.draft_tokens = torch.zeros((1, 1), dtype=torch.int64)
+    runner.prompt_logprobs_worker.compute_prompt_logprobs.return_value = {}
+    input_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        req_ids=["request"], idx_mapping=torch.tensor([0]), query_start_loc=None
+    )
+    runner.execute_model_state.input_batch = input_batch
+    runner.execute_model_state.num_spec_tokens_to_schedule = 0
+    runner.sample.return_value = (Mock(), torch.tensor([1]), torch.tensor([0]))
+
+    def postprocess(*args):
+        timeline.append("postprocess")
+        writes.add("postprocess")
+
+    def post_forward(*args):
+        timeline.append("post_forward")
+        writes.add("post_forward")
+
+    runner.postprocess_sampled.side_effect = postprocess
+    runner.kv_connector.post_forward.side_effect = post_forward
+    if has_speculator:
+        runner.speculator.supports_mm_inputs = False
+
+        def propose(*args, **kwargs):
+            assert timeline[:3] == ["d2h", "wait", "record"]
+            assert "draft" not in ready
+            timeline.append("draft")
+            writes.add("draft")
+            return torch.zeros((1, 1), dtype=torch.int64)
+
+        runner.speculator.propose.side_effect = propose
+    else:
+        runner.speculator = None
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        model_runner_module, "use_workspace_lane", lambda _: contextlib.nullcontext()
+    )
+    GPUModelRunner.sample_tokens(runner, None)
+    assert ("draft" in ready) == (has_speculator and requires_completion)
+    assert ("postprocess" in ready) == (has_speculator and requires_completion)
+    assert event.record.call_count == (
+        2 if has_speculator and requires_completion else 1
+    )
+    assert ("post_forward" in ready) == (has_speculator and requires_completion)
+    assert timeline == (
+        ["d2h", "wait", "record", "postprocess"]
+        + (["draft"] if has_speculator else [])
+        + ["post_forward"]
+        + (["wait", "record"] if has_speculator and requires_completion else [])
+    )
+    event.synchronize.assert_not_called()
+    copy_stream.synchronize.assert_not_called()
+    runner.main_stream.synchronize.assert_not_called()
